{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# Workflow derived from https://github.com/r-lib/actions/tree/v2/examples
# Need help debugging build failures? Start at https://github.com/r-lib/actions#where-to-find-help
# usethis::use_github_action("check-standard") will install it.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:

name: R-CMD-check.yaml

permissions: read-all

jobs:
  R-CMD-check:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.config.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 60

    name: ${{ matrix.config.os }} (${{ matrix.config.r }})

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        config:
          - {os: macos-latest,   r: 'release'}

          - {os: windows-latest, r: 'release'}
          # use 4.1 to check with rtools40's older compiler
          - {os: windows-latest, r: '4.1'}

          - {os: ubuntu-latest,   r: 'devel', http-user-agent: 'release'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,   r: 'release'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,   r: 'oldrel-1'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,   r: 'oldrel-2'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,   r: 'oldrel-3'}
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,   r: 'oldrel-4'}
          # Check the minimum supported R version
          - {os: ubuntu-latest,   r: '4.1'}

    env:
      GITHUB_PAT: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      R_KEEP_PKG_SOURCE: yes
      RSPM: ${{ matrix.config.rspm }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-pandoc@v2

      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
        with:
          r-version: ${{ matrix.config.r }}
          http-user-agent: ${{ matrix.config.http-user-agent }}
          cran: ${{ matrix.config.rspm }}

      # S7 needs R >= 4.2, so the R 4.1 jobs check covr without it.
      - uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r-dependencies@v2
        with:
          extra-packages: any::rcmdcheck, S7=?ignore-before-r=4.2.0
          needs: check

      # Lets the tests measure the coverage of Rust code. rustup's Rust for
      # the GNU ABI of Rtools has no profiler runtime, so this isn't possible
      # on Windows.
      - name: Install Rust's llvm-tools
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: rustup component add llvm-tools

      - uses: r-lib/actions/check-r-package@v2
        with:
          upload-snapshots: true
          build_args: 'c("--no-manual", "--compact-vignettes=gs+qpdf")'",
  "rationale": "The workflow defines a multi-configuration R CMD check matrix but has no job-level timeout, leaving runs unbounded. The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is supported by the retrieved pattern and experiment evidence, which shows custom timeouts reduce runaway consumption while preserving required checks. Repository CI history shows successful runs complete in roughly 10-16 minutes, so a 60-minute timeout provides operational headroom without affecting valid runs. This change preserves all matrix configurations, build steps, and test coverage; it only adds a safety bound. No permissions are weakened, no privileged actions or secrets are added, and no new network access is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}

      RSPM: ${{ matrix.config.rspm }}

      - name: Install Rust's llvm-tools

      - uses: r-lib/actions/check-r-package@v2
